exposure: repair of uterine incision inside the abdomen
repair of uterine incision outside the abdomen
cohort: 150 patients undergoing emergency cesarean procedures in a tertiary hospital
finding: Manual removal of the placenta resulted in higher blood loss, increased uterine tenderness, and longer hospitalization compared with the spontaneous separation method.
mod_finding: The uterine incision repair site did not affect morbidity.
